text.tspan: Variation from mean speed by ≥10kt (gust) AND speed before/after ≥15kt
Onset/cessation/change in FZ precip, FZFG, MOD/HVY precip, drifting/blowing snow, sand, dust, DS, TS, SS, squall, funnel clouds
Cloud below 450m changes: SKC/FEW/SCT↔BKN/OVC or BKN/OVC↔SKC/FEW/SCT
Sky obscured & vertical vis changes/passes 30,60,150,300m (where laser ceilometer installed)
Surface temp increases ≥2°C from last observation
